_comment: Copy to config.json (or point ARTEX_CONFIG at another path). This file only holds database and skill_dir; everything else (LLM etc.) comes from environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: ARTEX_PG_DSN env var over database in this file. Pick one of two styles: (A) fill in the split fields below; (B) fill in only the single full connection string database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): delete database above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty the split fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one subdirectory per skill, each containing SKILL.md). Precedence: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR env var over this field over the default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
